groups.name: CrudActionBenchmarks
groups.description: End-to-end CRUD against a real PostgreSQL database (Testcontainers): paged Query, single Get, Patch, Create, and create-then-Delete of JobDefinition rows. The table is pre-seeded with at least 2x Amount (min 100) rows so paging is exercised.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Page size requested by the Query case (10 or 50); also scales the seeded row count.

groups.name: MappingBenchmarks
groups.description: Object-to-DTO mapping via ILyoMapper (Mapster): a single entity and a 100-entity list, each carrying a nested child collection. ChildCount scales the nested collection so mapping cost reflects graph depth, not just row count.

parameters.name: ChildCount
parameters.description: Number of nested MapChild items per entity (0, 5, 25); the dominant cost driver beyond the flat fields.

dataset.notes: Entity with scalar fields plus a Children collection of MapChild (nested object), illustrating the nested mapping the row count alone hides.

measurements.description: Map one entity (with its ChildCount nested children) to its response DTO (baseline).
measurements.slaStandard: Object-to-DTO mapping of a single entity or a 100-entity list with nested children should be a low single-digit milliseconds at most.

measurements.description: Map a 100-entity list (each with ChildCount nested children) to response DTOs.

groups.name: ProjectionBenchmarks
groups.description: Projection pipeline over BenchPerson: resolve field specs, build the SQL projection expression, and project entities in memory. Covers a flat selection (Name, Age, IsActive) and a nested-path selection that reaches into the Address object and the Contacts collection (Name, Address.City, Contacts.Kind).

parameters.name: RowCount
parameters.description: Number of generated BenchPerson rows projected in memory (1,000 or 100,000).

dataset.notes: Projection selects flat fields plus nested paths (Address.City, Contacts.Kind) out of the full entity.

measurements.description: Resolve the requested field names into projected field specs (metadata only).
measurements.slaStandard: Resolving a handful of field specs is metadata-only and should be tens of microseconds at most.

measurements.description: Build the SQL projection expression from the resolved specs (no data scan).
measurements.slaStandard: Building a projection expression is a build-time step and should stay well under a millisecond.

measurements.description: Project the full in-memory entity set down to the selected flat fields and count results.
measurements.slaStandard: Reflection-based in-memory projection should stay around 1-1.5 us/row; up to 100k rows within ~150 ms.

measurements.description: Project the full in-memory entity set down to nested paths (Address.City, Contacts.Kind) and count results.
measurements.slaStandard: Nested-path projection walks object/collection members per row; up to 100k rows within ~200 ms (~2 us/row).

groups.name: WhereClauseBenchmarks

Covers expression build, IQueryable filtering, and single-entity matching.

name: query
title: Query & CRUD
description: Lyo.Query engine internals plus end-to-end CRUD. In-memory suites run the where-clause engine (expression build, filtering, single-entity match), ordering, object-to-DTO mapping, and the projection pipeline over generated BenchPerson rows (RowCount). The CRUD suite runs Query/Get/Patch/Create/Delete against a real PostgreSQL database (Testcontainers, Docker) paging Amount rows. Each class's data shape captures the entity/model structure being exercised, including nested collections.
